cards.text: Friend, the WHOLE nation of Israel has just finished crossing the Jordan River. Now the LORD speaks to Joshua, Israel's leader. Choose twelve men, He says, one from each tribe.

cards.question: The LORD has a job for those twelve men. What are they supposed to take up from the middle of the Jordan?
The twelve men are supposed to take them from the very spot where the priests were standing in the Jordan. True or false?

cards.text: So Joshua sends the twelve men back into the middle of the Jordan, each to take a stone up on his SHOULDER. Friend, that's not a pebble you slip in your apron pocket.

cards.question: Joshua says the stones will serve as a sign among Israel. Who does he say will one day ask what the stones mean?
When someone asks about the stones, Joshua tells Israel to answer that they won a great battle. True or false?
The waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of the LORD, so Joshua says the stones will be a ___ to the Israelites forever.

cards.text: And the Israelites do exactly as Joshua commanded, just as the LORD had told him. Twelve stones come up out of the middle of the Jordan, one for each tribe of Israel.

cards.question: The Israelites carry the twelve stones from the river to the ___ and set them down there.

cards.text: But Joshua isn't done with stones yet. He also sets up twelve stones himself.

cards.question: Where does Joshua set up these twelve stones?

answers.text: In the middle of the Jordan

cards.text: And the writer says those stones are there to this day. So where have the priests with the ark been all this time?

cards.question: While the people finish everything the LORD commanded Joshua to tell them, the priests carrying the ark wait on the far bank of the Jordan. True or false?

cards.text: It's all done just as Moses had directed Joshua, and the people hurried across. Friend, that's everybody when the crosswalk light starts blinking.

cards.question: Once everyone has finished crossing the Jordan, what do the priests with the ark of the LORD do?

answers.text: They cross over while the people watch
They stay in the river overnight
They go back to the east side

cards.text: Now meet the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, the tribes whose land is back on the east side of the Jordan (Joshua 1:12-15). They cross over ahead of the rest of Israel, as Moses had instructed them.

cards.question: The Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh cross ahead of the other Israelites. How do they go?

cards.text: About 40,000 troops armed for battle cross over before the LORD into the plains of Jericho. Friend, that's not a river crossing, that's a whole STADIUM emptying out after the game.

Before the crossing, the LORD made Joshua a promise about how all Israel would see him (Joshua 3:7). On that day He keeps it, and friend, the new guy at work is about to get a BIG moment in front of the whole office.

cards.question: On the day Israel crosses the Jordan, what does the LORD do for Joshua in the sight of all Israel?

answers.text: He gives him a new name

cards.question: Israel revered Joshua all the days of his life, just as they had revered ___.

cards.text: Then the LORD tells Joshua to command the priests who carry the ark of the Testimony to come up from the Jordan.
So Joshua commands the priests, "Come up from the Jordan." Up they climb with the ark, and their feet touch the dry land.

cards.question: The moment the priests carrying the ark step onto dry land, what happens to the Jordan?

answers.text: The waters return and overflow the banks
The riverbed stays dry until morning
The waters stand up in a heap again

cards.text: On the tenth day of the first month, the people go up from the Jordan and set up camp on the eastern border of Jericho.

cards.question: On the tenth day of the first month, Israel camps at ___ on the eastern border of Jericho.
At their new camp, Joshua sets up the twelve stones they took from the Jordan. True or false?

cards.text: Then Joshua says that one day their children will ask their fathers, 'What is the meaning of these stones?' Friend, Chip begged me for one more story EVERY night, so these dads with twelve stones on display are NEVER sleeping again.

cards.question: Joshua tells the fathers what to answer: Israel crossed the Jordan on ___ ground.
Joshua says the LORD dried up the Jordan just as He once dried up the Sea of Galilee. True or false?
Joshua tells Israel why the LORD dried up the Jordan. What reason does he give?

answers.text: So all peoples know His hand is mighty
So Israel could rest before the battle
So the priests could reach Jericho first

cards.question: Joshua gives Israel a second reason too: the LORD did it so they may always fear the LORD their God. True or false?

cards.text: Now the Amorite kings west of the Jordan and the Canaanite kings along the coast hear how the LORD dried up the Jordan before the Israelites. I bet that news moved faster than a group chat.

cards.question: When the Amorite and Canaanite kings hear how the LORD dried up the Jordan, how do they react?

answers.text: They gather their armies to attack
They send gifts asking for peace

cards.text: Their spirits fail for fear of the Israelites. Israel's made it to the other side, friend, but keep that apron on, because this story's timer hasn't gone off yet.
